name: Diagrams
description: Generate professional diagrams from natural language descriptions using Kroki.io. Supports 20+ diagram types including PlantUML, Mermaid, GraphViz, D2, C4, ERD, and more. Automatically selects the optimal diagram type, generates styled scripts, and renders PNG and SVG images.
longDescription:
